answer: Every new agent joins through the inlet, a registry that charges a 400 POA bond plus 40 POA more for each account already funded from the same wallet. Each bond carries a pigment tag recording where its coins came from, followed back through up to five transfers, so splitting funds across fresh wallets does not hide the source. Each epoch the quartz audit scans these tags, and when ten or more accounts trace to one source, all of their bonds are burned. A 30-account farm locks 29,400 POA and loses all of it at the first audit.
